name: Mido
notes: 2026-10-29: Candidate originated in conversation; listed-in-prd is a legacy listed-only status, not PRD inclusion.
2026-10-29: Port backends and devices are separately required; reading a MIDI file does not render its sound.
2026-10-29: Skill opportunity: possible standalone MIDI manipulation skill after a reproducible round-trip fixture and an existing-skill check.

evidence.result: Type-1, 480 TPB, two tracks and two note events; 500000 µs/beat tempo and 480-tick note-off preserved; 54-byte repeat saves identical (SHA-256 dfde7981717f295a00b1959fe1010fd5d0b37f6063e3022e4ec23324f33ac5b9).
evidence.scope: Mido 1.3.2 type-1 MIDI read/write round trip on macOS arm64; preserves declared tempo/note events and repeat bytes; no playback, ports or synthesis.

summary: Python library for MIDI 1.0 messages, ports and files. Supports inspecting and modifying symbolic events; live ports require an appropriate backend and are separate from audio synthesis.
use_when: Read and write MIDI events in Python
Inspect MIDI messages or ports without rendering audio
license: MIT (library code; backends and musical content require separate review)

assessment.rationale: Official documentation covers Python MIDI 1.0; PyPI release 1.3.3 is dated 2024-10-25. Recent substantive commit activity was not established.
